text.description: One independently verifiable factual or interpretive proposition. The first claim must directly fulfill the current answerFocus; split compound propositions into separate claims.

evidenceIds.description: Existing packet evidence IDs that together directly support the complete proposition.

role.description: The exact part of this claim that the quotation supports, including how it addresses the current answerFocus when applicable.

evidenceIds.description: Existing packet evidence IDs that together directly support the complete proposition.

limitations.description: Specific evidence gaps only, including a missing requested rationale or authority when applicable.

clarifyingQuestion.description: Null unless clarification is needed or one tightly related continuation follows naturally.

humanGuidanceRecommended.description: False for ordinary explanatory, historical, textual, and source-identification questions.
